purpose: Module import/startup diagnostic only; not command end-to-end timing or a target-qualified performance sample. No bundle is shipped based on this diagnostic.
method: Ten source imports followed by ten imports of an esbuild bundle, separate Node processes; shared host and concurrently running model experiments. The bundle retains original source import.meta.url values for this diagnostic only.
initial_trial: The first bundle could not load because an ESM bundle lacked createRequire for yaml/process. It yielded no valid bundled samples; the diagnostic was rerun after adding the require shim.

whole_command_diagnostic.limitations: Five samples per case without signed records, unbalanced sequential order, models and supplemental replay used the same shared VM. Not a target-eligible result. Bundled path preserves source URLs solely for this diagnostic. No production dependency or package change.
